## 📋 Module Overview

This module introduces the core principles of **Object-Oriented Programming**, which forms the foundation for modern software development.

## 📚 Course Structure

::: {.callout-note}
## Module Contents
- **Chapter 1** — Introduction to OOP: Classes & Objects
- **Chapter 2** — Encapsulation & Abstraction
- **Chapter 3** — Inheritance & Polymorphism
- **Chapter 4** — Design Patterns (Singleton, Factory, Observer)
- **Chapter 5** — Advanced OOP: Interfaces & Abstract Classes
:::
